## Claims
- [source-backed] For \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), \(J_v\) has two Schur generating families indexed respectively by \(i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\) and \(i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\), each of size \(\binom{a+b}{a}\). [source-2, lines 1380-1421]
- [source-backed] The paper formally conjectures that both such generating sets are minimal, and reports finite computer verification only for \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [source-2, lines 1489-1502]
- [source-backed] The stronger unresolved statement is \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\); the authors state that a proof had eluded them. [source-2, lines 1536-1552]
- [source-backed] The source directory also records the related open question of finding a minimal generating set for \(I_w\) in type \(A_{n-1}\). [source-6, lines 88-102]
- [proved] If \(Q\) is generated by marked elements \(g_1,\ldots,g_N\), and for every \(\ell\) there is a prime \(p_\ell\) such that \(g_\ell\) has nonzero image in \(Q/(\sum_{k\ne\ell}\mathbb Zg_k+p_\ell Q)\), then \(\{g_\ell\}\) is inclusion-minimal.
- [proved] Minimality does not imply the stronger torsion-free quotient conjecture: the standard basis minimally generates \((\mathbb Z/2)^N\), although this group is not \(\mathbb Z^N\).

## Strategy
The source proposition reduces ideal minimality to minimal spanning in
\(Q=J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\). [source-2, lines 1520-1540] A direct integral route is therefore:

1. Present \(Q\) degreewise using the two Schur families and all positive-degree multiplication relations.
2. For minimality alone, apply the displayed prime-by-prime nonredundancy test to each proposed generator.
3. For the stronger conjecture, compute integral Smith normal forms and prove every invariant factor is \(1\).

The proved criterion follows because membership of \(g_\ell\) in the span of the other \(g_k\) would force its image to vanish in every indicated quotient.

## Gaps
No supplied source provides a complete integral relation matrix for \(Q\) in general parameters. Hence neither the required Smith forms nor the prime witnesses are available here. The source itself records the freeness statement as unresolved.

## Next
Construct a general degreewise Schur/Pieri presentation of \(Q\), then seek either unimodular complements proving freeness or prime-field witnesses proving only minimality.
